message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime based on facts: illegal welding causing fire, property damage. Likely "故意毁坏财物罪" (intentional destruction of property) under Criminal Law article 275? Actually article 275: "故意毁坏公私财物，数额较大" is punishable. Here the act was negligent? He lacked skill, but still caused fire. Could be "过失毁坏财物罪" (negligent destruction of property) under article 276. The facts: He performed welding without professional skill, causing fire. That seems negligence, not intent. So crime: "过失毁坏财物罪". Also maybe "放火罪"? But fire was not intentional, so not arson. So answer: [罪名]过失毁坏财物罪<eoa>.
